accolade.en: Winning the campus writing prize felt like the highest accolade of her semester.
accolade.zh: 贏得校園寫作獎，對她來說像是這學期最高的榮譽肯定。

kudos.en: The cast earned well-deserved kudos after the sold-out opening night.
kudos.zh: 開幕夜場場爆滿後，全劇組贏得了實至名歸的讚譽。

plaudit.en: Every sincere plaudit from the audience made the nervous pianist smile.
plaudit.zh: 觀眾每一句真誠的喝彩，都讓緊張的鋼琴家露出笑容。

commendation.en: The firefighter received a formal commendation for pulling the family from the smoke.
commendation.zh: 這位消防隊員因把一家人從濃煙中救出，而獲正式嘉獎。

adulate.en: Fans who adulate every celebrity tweet often forget to think for themselves.
adulate.zh: 對名人每則推文都一味奉承的粉絲，常常忘了獨立思考。

adulation.en: Constant adulation from strangers made the young star uneasy and guarded.
adulation.zh: 陌生人不斷的諂媚吹捧，讓這位年輕明星不安又防範。

flatter.en: He tried to flatter the judge with empty praise, but she saw through it instantly.
flatter.zh: 他試圖用空洞讚美奉承法官，但她立刻看穿了。

blandishment.en: No blandishment from the salesman could persuade her to buy the overpriced phone.
blandishment.zh: 業務員再怎麼甜言蜜語，也說不動她去買那支超貴的手機。

truckle.en: She refused to truckle to the boss just to keep a dull office job.
truckle.zh: 她拒絕為了保住一份無聊的辦公室工作，而屈從討好上司。

excoriate.en: The columnist moved to excoriate the mayor for ignoring the flooded neighborhoods.
excoriate.zh: 專欄作家嚴厲譴責市長對淹水社區視而不見。

berate.en: The coach began to berate the team for skipping practice before the final game.
berate.zh: 教練因決賽前翹練而痛斥整支球隊。

upbraid.en: Mom would upbraid us gently whenever we left dirty dishes in the sink overnight.
upbraid.zh: 只要我們把髒碗放水槽過夜，媽媽就會溫和地責備我們。

vilify.en: Online rumors tried to vilify the teacher before anyone checked the facts.
vilify.zh: 網路謠言在無人查證前，就試圖辱罵抹黑那位老師。

revile.en: Angry fans continued to revile the referee long after the final whistle blew.
revile.zh: 終場哨響後很久，憤怒球迷仍不停辱罵那位裁判。

belittle.en: Please do not belittle a classmate's project just because the topic seems simple.
belittle.zh: 請不要只因題目看起來簡單，就貶低同學的專題。

decry.en: Local parents rose to decry the sudden cut in after-school music programs.
decry.zh: 當地家長挺身譴責課後音樂課程突然被刪減。

chide.en: The librarian had to chide the group for whispering through the quiet reading hour.
chide.zh: 管理員不得不責備那群人在安靜閱讀時段一直竊竊私語。

bouquet.en: She carried a modest bouquet of wildflowers into the small school auditorium.
bouquet.zh: 她捧著一束樸素的野花走進小小的學校禮堂。

whip.en: The rider hung the unused whip on a hook beside the stable door.
whip.zh: 騎士把沒用到的鞭子掛在馬廄門旁的鉤子上。

heckle.en: A few students tried to heckle the guest speaker with rude interruptions.
heckle.zh: 幾個學生用不禮貌的插話，試圖質問干擾來賓演講。

encore.en: The crowd shouted for an encore until the band returned with one more song.
encore.zh: 觀眾高喊安可，直到樂團再回來加唱一首。

roast.en: At the charity roast, friends teased the host with jokes that never turned cruel.
roast.zh: 在慈善吐槽大會上，朋友們用玩笑調侃主持人，卻從不刻薄傷人。

publicize.en: The club will publicize the blood drive on posters all across campus.
publicize.zh: 社團會用滿校園的海報，宣傳這次捐血活動。

closet.en: She kept the birthday gifts hidden in the hall closet until Saturday morning.
closet.zh: 她把生日禮物藏在走廊壁櫥裡，直到週六早上才拿出來。

secluded.en: They rented a secluded cabin where no traffic noise could reach the porch.
secluded.zh: 他們租了一間隱居般的小屋，門廊聽不到任何車聲。

classified.en: Only staff with clearance may open that classified folder on the secure drive.
classified.zh: 只有取得許可的人員，才能開啟安全硬碟上那份機密資料夾。

plaza.en: Street musicians filled the sunny plaza with soft guitar music at noon.
plaza.zh: 中午時，街頭樂手用輕柔吉他聲填滿陽光灑落的廣場。

booth.en: The radio host recorded the interview inside a soundproof booth downtown.
booth.zh: 電台主持人在市中心一間隔音房裡錄製訪談。

folder.en: Please drop your signed permission slip into the blue folder on my desk.
folder.zh: 請把簽好名的同意書放進我桌上那本藍色資料夾。

lock.en: He replaced the rusty lock on the garden gate before winter storms arrived.
lock.zh: 冬季風暴來前，他先換掉花園大門上生鏽的鎖。

poster.en: A bright poster for the spring musical hung beside the cafeteria entrance.
poster.zh: 春日音樂劇的鮮豔海報，掛在餐廳入口旁。

chaste.en: The poem kept a chaste tone, avoiding any flashy or suggestive imagery.
chaste.zh: 這首詩語氣純潔克制，避開一切華麗或挑逗的意象。

immaculate.en: Her notes were immaculate, with every date and source neatly underlined.
immaculate.zh: 她的筆記毫無瑕疵，每個日期與出處都整齊畫線。

unsullied.en: He hoped his reputation would remain unsullied after the messy campus rumor.
unsullied.zh: 經歷校園謠言風波後，他仍希望自己的名聲保持未受玷污。

pure.en: The mountain spring tasted pure and cold after the long dusty hike.
pure.zh: 走完漫長塵土飛揚的健行後，山泉嘗起來純淨又清涼。

stainless.en: She kept a stainless record of honesty through four years of student government.
stainless.zh: 在四年學生自治會任內，她保持了無瑕疵的誠實紀錄。

besmirch.en: False posts tried to besmirch his name before the student election even began.
besmirch.zh: 假貼文試圖在學生會選舉開始前就玷污他的名聲。

blemish.en: One late assignment should not leave a permanent blemish on an otherwise strong record.
blemish.zh: 一次遲交不該在原本優秀的成績單上留下永久污點。

defile.en: Dumping paint into the creek would defile the park that kids use every weekend.
defile.zh: 把油漆倒進小溪，會污染孩子們每週末使用的公園。

sully.en: A single unfair accusation can sully years of careful, honest work.
sully.zh: 一則不公指控，就能玷污多年謹慎誠實的努力。

tarnish.en: Humidity made the silver trophies tarnish until they looked dull gray.
tarnish.zh: 濕氣讓銀獎盃失去光澤，看起來變成暗灰色。

whiterobe.en: The choir director handed each singer a clean whiterobe before the winter concert.
whiterobe.zh: 冬季音樂會前，合唱指揮發給每位歌手一件乾淨白袍。

ink.en: Blue ink spilled across the worksheet and stained half of the answer blanks.
ink.zh: 藍色墨汁洒在學習單上，染髒了一半作答格。

laundry.en: She dropped the muddy jerseys at the corner laundry after Saturday practice.
laundry.zh: 週六練習後，她把沾泥球衣送到街角洗衣店。

spot.en: A coffee spot on his white shirt made him change before the oral exam.
spot.zh: 白襯衫上的咖啡斑點，讓他在口試前不得不換衣。

bleach.en: Use mild bleach carefully if you want to remove the mold from the tile grout.
bleach.zh: 若要清除磁磚縫的霉斑，請小心使用溫和漂白水。

soap.en: She washed the paint off her hands with warm water and fragrant soap.
soap.zh: 她用溫水和香皂把手上的顏料洗掉。

splash.en: Kids love to splash cold water at each other beside the outdoor fountain.
splash.zh: 孩子們喜歡在戶外噴水池旁互相濺潑冷水。

adamant.en: She stayed adamant that group members must cite every source in the paper.
adamant.zh: 她堅決要求組員在報告中必須標註每一個出處。

pliable.en: Warm clay feels pliable in your hands before it hardens on the pottery wheel.
pliable.zh: 陶土在轉盤上變硬前，握在手裡感覺柔軟好塑形。

yielding.en: The foam mat was yielding underfoot, soft enough for morning stretch drills.
yielding.zh: 泡棉墊踩起來柔軟服貼，適合晨間伸展練習。

mulish.en: His mulish refusal to revise one paragraph cost the team an easy rewrite win.
mulish.zh: 他固執如驢、拒絕改一段文字，讓小組錯失輕鬆重寫拿分的機會。

pigheaded.en: Even clear photos could not shake her pigheaded belief that the rumor was true.
pigheaded.zh: 即使有清楚照片，也動搖不了她那頑固的謠言信念。

amenable.en: New volunteers proved amenable to the schedule once the coach explained the reason.
amenable.zh: 教練說明原因後，新志工變得很聽話、願意配合時間表。

pliant.en: Heat made the plastic strip pliant enough to bend around the model frame.
pliant.zh: 加熱後塑膠條變得柔軟，足以彎繞模型骨架。

docile.en: The usually lively puppy grew docile after a long walk in the park.
docile.zh: 平常活潑的小狗，在公園長走後變得溫順安靜。

yoga.en: She joined a lunchtime yoga class to loosen stiff shoulders after typing all morning.
yoga.zh: 打字一整早後，她去上午休瑜珈課放鬆僵硬肩膀。

cement.en: Workers poured fresh cement for the new sidewalk outside the science building.
cement.zh: 工人在科學大樓外，為新行人步道灌注新鮮水泥。

bend.en: You must bend the wire carefully so the circuit board connector fits without snapping.
bend.zh: 你必須小心地彎曲線材，才能讓電路板接頭卡住又不折斷。

stubborn.en: The stubborn printer jammed again until someone cleared the wrinkled paper path.
stubborn.zh: 那台固執的印表機又卡住，直到有人清掉皺紙紙道。

softness.en: The softness of the new sweater made winter mornings feel almost gentle.
softness.zh: 新毛衣的柔軟觸感，讓冬日早晨幾乎變得溫柔。

stretch.en: Athletes stretch their calves before every sprint so the muscles stay loose.
stretch.zh: 選手每次衝刺前都會伸展小腿，讓肌肉保持放鬆。

brick.en: One loose brick near the library steps needed to be reset after the rain.
brick.zh: 雨後圖書館台階旁有一塊鬆動的磚，需要重新嵌好。

rubber.en: The lab stool had a rubber foot that stopped it from sliding across the floor.
rubber.zh: 實驗凳有橡膠腳墊，能防止在地板上滑動。

hinge.en: Whether the grant arrives on time is the hinge of our entire spring timeline.
hinge.zh: 補助是否準時到位，是整個春季時程的關鍵。

lockdown.en: During the surprise lockdown drill, hallway doors stayed shut for fifteen minutes.
lockdown.zh: 突襲封鎖演練期間，走廊門關閉了十五分鐘。

giveway.en: After a long debate, the committee offered a small giveway on the deadline rule.
giveway.zh: 長辯論後，委員會在截止期限規定上做了一點讓步。

steel.en: The sculpture used recycled steel beams from an old bridge downtown.
steel.zh: 這座雕塑使用了市中心舊橋拆下的回收鋼樑。

clay.en: First-year art students pressed wet clay into simple bowls for the kiln.
clay.zh: 大一美術生把濕黏土壓成簡單碗形，準備進窯。

mat.en: Leave your muddy shoes on the entry mat before walking into the classroom.
mat.zh: 進教室前，請把泥鞋放在門口墊子上。

bolsterpad.en: She tucked a soft bolsterpad behind her back during the long bus ride home.
bolsterpad.zh: 坐長途公車回家時，她在背後塞了一個柔軟靠墊。

donkey.en: A patient donkey carried picnic baskets up the short trail to the overlook.
donkey.zh: 一頭耐心的驢子，把野餐籃馱上通往觀景台的短步道。

whipcord.en: The old riding glove still had a thin whipcord loop sewn at the wrist.
whipcord.zh: 那隻舊騎馬手套腕部，仍縫著一圈細細的鞭繩。

flex.en: Watch the gymnast flex her wrists slowly before she mounts the uneven bars.
flex.zh: 看體操選手上高低槓前，慢慢屈曲手腕熱身。

rigidbar.en: Engineers bolted a rigidbar across the frame so the shelf would not sag.
rigidbar.zh: 工程師在框架上鎖上一根硬棒，避免架子下垂。

paucity.en: A paucity of quiet study rooms forced students into noisy cafe corners.
paucity.zh: 安靜自習室缺乏，逼得學生擠進嘈雜咖啡角落。

plethora.en: A plethora of club flyers covered every bulletin board by the first week.
plethora.zh: 開學第一週，佈告欄就被過量的社團傳單貼滿。

abundance.en: An abundance of ripe apples arrived from the orchard for the bake sale.
abundance.zh: 果園送來充裕的成熟蘋果，供應義賣烘焙攤。

sparse.en: Only sparse grass grew along the dry path behind the sports field.
sparse.zh: 運動場後方乾旱小徑上，只長著稀疏的草。

exiguous.en: Their exiguous travel budget allowed only one shared taxi to the museum.
exiguous.zh: 他們稀少的旅費預算，只夠合搭一輛計程車去美術館。

paltry.en: The prize money looked paltry next to the hours of rehearsal students invested.
paltry.zh: 相較學生投入的排練時數，那筆獎金顯得微不足道。

puny.en: Compared with last year's festival, this week's turnout looked puny and thin.
puny.zh: 和去年的嘉年華相比，這週的出席人數顯得微不足道又稀稀落落。

scant.en: With scant daylight left, hikers hurried down before the trail grew dark.
scant.zh: 剩餘日光稀少，健行者趕緊下山，免得步道變暗。

scrimp.en: They had to scrimp on snacks all month to afford the train tickets home.
scrimp.zh: 為了負擔回家火車票，他們整個月都得節省零食支出。

skimp.en: Do not skimp on sleep before finals if you want a clear head in the morning.
skimp.zh: 若想早上頭腦清醒，期末前別吝於睡覺、別偷減睡眠。

stint.en: She would not stint on kindness when a homesick roommate needed company.
stint.zh: 室友想家需要陪伴時，她絕不吝惜善意。

anemic.en: The debate felt anemic until someone raised a sharp question about fairness.
anemic.zh: 辯論一直缺乏活力，直到有人提出關於公平的尖銳問題。

famine.en: History class studied how drought and war once led to a devastating famine.
famine.zh: 歷史課研讀乾旱與戰爭如何曾導致毀滅性饑荒。

glut.en: Cheap streaming apps can glut your evenings until free time disappears.
glut.zh: 廉價串流軟體可能讓你晚上過量刷劇，直到空閒時間消失。

surfeit.en: After a surfeit of dessert samples, nobody wanted another slice of cake.
surfeit.zh: 試吃過量甜點後，再也沒人想再來一塊蛋糕。

opulence.en: The hotel lobby showed quiet opulence with marble floors and soft lighting.
opulence.zh: 飯店大廳以大理石地與柔光，展現低調的富裕氣派。

bounteous.en: Neighbors shared a bounteous harvest of tomatoes from the community garden.
bounteous.zh: 鄰居們分享社區菜園裡慷慨豐盛的番茄收成。

exuberance.en: Her exuberance after the win lit up the whole locker room with laughter.
exuberance.zh: 獲勝後她熱情洋溢，讓整個更衣室充滿笑聲。

lush.en: Rain turned the campus courtyard into a lush carpet of deep green grass.
lush.zh: 雨水把校園中庭變成一片茂盛濃綠的草地。

rife.en: Rumors were rife in the hallway before the principal posted the real notice.
rife.zh: 校長張貼正式公告前，走廊裡謠言四處充斥。

scads.en: There were scads of unfinished drafts piled beside her laptop last night.
scads.zh: 昨晚她筆電旁堆著大量未完成的草稿。

superfluity.en: Packing for one weekend, she discarded every superfluity from her overflowing bag.
superfluity.zh: 只打包一個週末，她把書包裡每樣多餘物品都拿掉。

sybaritic.en: A sybaritic spa weekend felt odd after months of cramped dorm life.
sybaritic.zh: 擠宿舍好幾個月後，一個驕奢逸樂的溫泉週末顯得格格不入。

magnanimous.en: The winning team was magnanimous, praising the rivals for a hard-fought match.
magnanimous.zh: 冠軍隊寬宏大量，稱讚對手打了一場硬仗。

ebullience.en: His morning ebullience made even the sleepy bus ride feel brighter.
ebullience.zh: 他早上的熱情奔放，連昏沉的公車程都顯得明亮些。

mint.en: She spent a mint on textbooks that first September at college.
mint.zh: 大學第一個九月，她在教科書上花了一大筆錢。

regale.en: Grandpa would regale us with camping stories until the fire burned low.
regale.zh: 爺爺會用露營故事款待我們，直到營火漸漸變小。

slash.en: The city had to slash festival spending after tax revenue fell sharply.
slash.zh: 稅收大幅下滑後，市府不得不大量削減節慶支出。

decimate.en: A sudden hailstorm can decimate a fruit orchard in a single afternoon.
decimate.zh: 一場突如其來的冰雹，可能在一個下午大量毀壞果園。

bolster.en: Extra practice sessions helped bolster her confidence before the oral defense.
bolster.zh: 額外練習時段幫助支撐她在口試答辯前的信心。

corroborate.en: Two classmates could corroborate that he was in the library during the theft.
corroborate.zh: 兩位同學能證實，竊案發生時他人在圖書館。

endorse.en: Three professors agreed to endorse her application for the research internship.
endorse.zh: 三位教授同意認可並背書她的研究實習申請。

uphold.en: Student leaders vowed to uphold the honor code during every take-home exam.
uphold.zh: 學生領袖誓言在每次回家考試中維護榮譽守則。

champion.en: She continued to champion free tutoring for first-year students all semester.
champion.zh: 她整學期持續擁護為大一新生提供免費課輔。

vindicate.en: The recovered security video helped vindicate him after weeks of unfair blame.
vindicate.zh: 找回的監視錄影，在數週不公指責後幫他洗清嫌疑。

auspices.en: The language festival ran under the auspices of the international student office.
auspices.zh: 語言祭在國際學生辦公室的贊助保護下舉行。

espouse.en: Many voters still espouse the idea that public libraries deserve steady funding.
espouse.zh: 許多選民仍擁護公共圖書館應獲得穩定經費的想法。

undermine.en: Constant late-night gossip can undermine trust inside a small project team.
undermine.zh: 持續的深夜八卦，會暗中破壞小型專題小組內的信任。

sabotage.en: Someone tried to sabotage the science fair by hiding the demo power cords.
sabotage.zh: 有人試圖藏起展示用電源線，蓄意破壞科學展。

subversive.en: The underground zine printed subversive cartoons that mocked strict dress rules.
subversive.zh: 地下刊物印出顛覆性漫畫，嘲諷嚴格服裝規定。

enervate.en: Humidity and late nights can enervate even a usually energetic runner.
enervate.zh: 濕氣加上熬夜，能讓平常精力充沛的跑者也變得衰弱。

attenuate.en: Thick curtains help attenuate street noise during early morning study hours.
attenuate.zh: 厚窗簾有助於在清晨自習時段減弱街上噪音。

hamstring.en: Missing bus schedules can hamstring students who work evening shifts off campus.
hamstring.zh: 公車時刻對不上，會阻礙需要在校外上晚班的學生。

sap.en: Endless group chats can sap your focus right before a difficult midterm.
sap.zh: 沒完沒了的群組訊息，會在困難期中考前削弱你的專注力。

blight.en: Abandoned storefronts blight the once busy street near the old train station.
blight.zh: 廢棄店面損害了舊火車站附近一度熱鬧的街道。

taint.en: One dishonest grade can taint an otherwise honest academic record forever.
taint.zh: 一次不誠實的成績，可能永遠玷污原本誠實的學業紀錄。

tamper.en: Please do not tamper with the lab scales; even a tiny shift ruins measurements.
tamper.zh: 請勿擅自破壞或亂動實驗秤；再小的偏移也會毀了測量。

detriment.en: Skipping breakfast to the detriment of concentration is a common exam-day mistake.
detriment.zh: 為了趕時間不吃早餐而損害專注力，是考試日常見錯誤。

overthrow.en: In the novel, rebels plot to overthrow a king who ignores the starving villages.
overthrow.zh: 小說裡，叛軍密謀推翻那位無視飢餓村落的國王。

mar.en: A cracked phone screen can mar an otherwise perfect graduation day photo.
mar.zh: 破裂的手機螢幕，可能損害原本完美的畢業典禮照片。

iconoclastic.en: His iconoclastic essays challenged fashion rules the school had never questioned.
iconoclastic.zh: 他那些破除傳統偶像的文章，挑戰了學校從未質疑過的時尚規範。

subvention.en: A small government subvention kept the community theater lights on all winter.
subvention.zh: 一筆小小的政府津貼，讓社區劇場整冬燈火不熄。

budge.en: The committee would not budge on the safety rule, no matter how late the request.
budge.zh: 無論申請多晚，委員會在安全規定上就是不肯改變立場。

embody.en: Her calm speech seemed to embody the values the scholarship committee admired.
embody.zh: 她沉穩的演講，似乎體現了獎學金委員會所欣賞的價值。

celerity.en: With surprising celerity, the volunteer team cleared the hall after the concert.
celerity.zh: 志工隊以驚人的迅速，在音樂會後清出場地。

dispatch.en: She handled the ticket problems with quiet dispatch and got everyone seated.
dispatch.zh: 她安靜又迅速地處理票務問題，讓大家都入座。

expeditious.en: An expeditious reply from the registrar saved him from missing the add deadline.
expeditious.zh: 註冊組迅速回覆，讓他免於錯過加選截止日。

prompt.en: A prompt apology after the misunderstanding calmed the whole group chat.
prompt.zh: 誤會後的即時道歉，讓整個群組聊天冷靜下來。

hasty.en: A hasty conclusion from one rumor can hurt someone who never got a hearing.
hasty.zh: 根據一則謠言就草率下結論，可能傷害從未被聽取的人。

fleet.en: The deer was fleet enough to vanish into the trees before anyone raised a camera.
fleet.zh: 那隻鹿速度夠快，在有人舉起相機前就消失進樹林。

bovine.en: His bovine stare during the lecture suggested he had slept through the night before.
bovine.zh: 他課堂上那遲鈍如牛的眼神，暗示前一晚幾乎沒睡。

dilatory.en: Dilatory replies from the landlord delayed every repair in the student apartment.
dilatory.zh: 房東磨蹭的回覆，拖延了學生公寓每一次維修。

laggard.en: The last laggard finally caught up when the tour guide waited at the museum door.
laggard.zh: 導遊在美術館門口等候時，最後一個落後者終於趕上。

sluggish.en: After lunch the class felt sluggish until someone opened the windows for air.
sluggish.zh: 午餐後全班感覺遲緩，直到有人開窗換氣。

dawdle.en: If you dawdle in the hallway, you will miss the first five minutes of chemistry.
dawdle.zh: 若在走廊混日子閒晃，你會錯過化學課前五分鐘。

drawl.en: He tended to drawl each vowel when telling stories about his hometown summers.
drawl.zh: 講起家鄉夏天故事時，他常慢吞吞地拉長每個母音。

loiter.en: Security asked teens not to loiter near the station exit after midnight.
loiter.zh: 保全要求青少年午夜後不要在車站出口附近閒逛。

lightning.en: A flash of lightning lit the dorm courtyard during the sudden evening storm.
lightning.zh: 突如其來的晚間暴風雨中，一道閃電照亮宿舍中庭。

snail.en: A tiny snail left a shiny trail across the wet chalkboard eraser tray.
snail.zh: 一隻小蝸牛在潮濕的黑板擦托盤上留下亮亮的痕跡。

package.en: The mailroom held a package of books that arrived too late for the reading week.
package.zh: 收發室扣留了一包書，可惜來得太晚趕不上閱讀週。

meeting.en: Our project meeting moved to the quiet room beside the library stairs.
meeting.zh: 我們的專題會議改到圖書館階梯旁的安靜房間。

turbo.en: The mechanic explained how a turbo forces more air into the small engine.
turbo.zh: 技師解釋渦輪如何把更多空氣壓進小型引擎。

brake.en: She pressed the brake gently as the school bus approached the icy corner.
brake.zh: 校車接近結冰轉角時，她輕輕踩下煞車。

sprint.en: He saved one final sprint for the last fifty meters of the charity race.
sprint.zh: 慈善路跑最後五十公尺，他留下衝刺力氣衝刺。

chatty.en: The chatty seatmate on the train kept sharing snacks and travel tips.
chatty.zh: 火車上那位愛聊天的鄰座，一直分享零食與旅行小撇步。

prattle.en: Toddlers prattle happily about dinosaurs while parents wait in the clinic lobby.
prattle.zh: 幼兒在診所大廳開心閒聊恐龍，家長則在一旁等候。

evanescent.en: The rainbow was evanescent, fading before anyone finished taking a photo.
evanescent.zh: 彩虹稍縱即逝，還沒人拍完照就消散了。

transient.en: Their transient joy at winning faded when the makeup exam schedule arrived.
transient.zh: 獲勝的短暫喜悅，在補考日程公布後就淡了。

provisional.en: The club offered a provisional schedule until the gym renovation dates were fixed.
provisional.zh: 在體育館整修日期確定前，社團先提供臨時課表。

tentative.en: We made a tentative plan for Saturday, knowing rain might force a change.
tentative.zh: 我們訂了週六暫定計畫，知道下雨可能被迫改期。

fleeting.en: A fleeting smile crossed her face when the surprise guest walked onstage.
fleeting.zh: 驚喜嘉賓走上舞台時，她臉上閃過飛逝一笑。

impromptu.en: An impromptu sing-along filled the bus after the power outage canceled the show.
impromptu.zh: 停電取消演出後，車上臨時發起即興合唱。

makeshift.en: They built a makeshift desk from two crates and a borrowed plywood board.
makeshift.zh: 他們用兩只木箱和一塊借來的夾板，搭出臨時湊合的書桌。

respite.en: A short respite under the shade gave the hikers strength for the final climb.
respite.zh: 樹蔭下短暫休息，讓健行者有力氣完成最後爬升。

reprieve.en: A weekend reprieve from deadlines let her sleep without setting an alarm.
reprieve.zh: 週末暫緩交件壓力，讓她能不設鬧鐘好好睡。

fad.en: The neon shoelace fad lasted one month and then vanished from campus fashion.
fad.zh: 螢光鞋帶這股短暫流行只撐一個月，就從校園時尚消失。

impermanence.en: The exhibit explored the impermanence of sand sculptures washed away by tides.
impermanence.zh: 展覽探討沙雕被潮水沖走的無常與暫時性。

abiding.en: She kept an abiding love for piano lessons long after childhood recitals ended.
abiding.zh: 童年鋼琴發表會結束後很久，她仍保持持久的鋼琴課熱愛。

perennial.en: Parking shortages are a perennial complaint at the start of every fall term.
perennial.zh: 停車位不足是每年秋季開學時的常年抱怨。

perpetuate.en: Repeating a false story online can perpetuate harm long after the facts appear.
perpetuate.zh: 在網路重複假故事，可能在真相出現後仍使傷害長存。

eternal.en: The mural promised eternal friendship among classmates who painted it together.
eternal.zh: 壁畫承諾一起彩繪的同學之間有永久友誼。

incessant.en: Incessant construction noise made afternoon naps almost impossible in the dorm.
incessant.zh: 不停的工地噪音，讓宿舍下午幾乎無法小睡。

outlast.en: Good habits can outlast a single exam season and shape your whole semester.
outlast.zh: 好習慣能比單一考季更持久，並形塑整個學期。

durable.en: These durable backpacks survive rain, bus rides, and four years of heavy books.
durable.zh: 這些耐用背包經得起雨淋、搭車，以及四年沉重課本。

recurrent.en: A recurrent headache every Monday made her rethink late Sunday study marathons.
recurrent.zh: 每週一再出現的頭痛，讓她重新思考週日熬夜讀書馬拉松。

sequester.en: Writers sometimes sequester themselves in a quiet cabin to finish a draft.
sequester.zh: 作家有時會把自己隔絕在安靜小屋，專心寫完草稿。

intermission.en: During intermission, the audience stretched and bought snacks in the lobby.
intermission.zh: 中場休息時，觀眾在大廳伸懶腰並買零食。

offhand.en: His offhand remark about the budget sounded careless, though he meant no harm.
offhand.zh: 他對預算的即興隨便評論聽來輕率，雖然他無意傷害。

rugged.en: The rugged hillside path demanded hiking boots instead of thin campus sneakers.
rugged.zh: 崎嶇山坡小徑需要登山靴，而不是單薄的校園球鞋。

purgatory.en: Waiting for delayed grades felt like a tiny academic purgatory each December.
purgatory.zh: 每年十二月等延遲成績，都像短暫的學術煉獄。

calamity.en: The flood was a calamity that closed three schools for the entire spring.
calamity.zh: 那場洪水是大災難，讓三所學校整個春天都關閉。

cantankerous.en: The cantankerous neighbor complained about every basketball bounce after six.
cantankerous.zh: 那位脾氣差的鄰居，對六點後每一次籃球彈跳都抱怨。

testy.en: Lack of sleep made him testy during group work, snapping at tiny delays.
testy.zh: 睡眠不足讓他在分組作業時易怒，對一點點延遲就發脾氣。

agreeable.en: An agreeable host made the awkward alumni dinner feel warm and easy.
agreeable.zh: 討人喜歡的主人，讓尷尬的校友晚宴變得溫暖輕鬆。

good-natured.en: Her good-natured teasing never crossed the line into mean classroom jokes.
good-natured.zh: 她脾氣好的調侃，從不越界變成傷人的課堂玩笑。

cranky.en: Toddlers get cranky when naps are skipped and snacks arrive too late.
cranky.zh: 幼兒若跳過午睡又零食來得太晚，就會變得暴躁。

cordial.en: The principal gave a cordial welcome to parents touring the new science wing.
cordial.zh: 校長熱誠歡迎參觀新科學樓的家長。

frugal.en: A frugal student cooked rice and vegetables instead of ordering delivery nightly.
frugal.zh: 節儉的學生自己煮飯菜，而不是每晚叫外送。

thrifty.en: Thrifty shoppers compared thrift-store jackets before buying anything new.
thrifty.zh: 節約的購物者會先比較二手店外套，再決定是否買新的。

economical.en: Taking the tram proved more economical than driving and paying for parking.
economical.zh: 搭電車比開車再付停車費更節省。

husband.en: Campers must husband drinking water carefully on the long dry ridge trail.
husband.zh: 在漫長乾燥山脊步道上，露營者必須勤儉持家般珍惜飲用水。

profligate.en: His profligate spending on gadgets left him broke before rent was due.
profligate.zh: 他對電子產品揮霍無度，租金到期前就破產了。

lavish.en: The club threw a lavish welcome banquet that used up half the semester budget.
lavish.zh: 社團辦了一場奢華歡迎宴，花掉半個學期的預算。

spendthrift.en: Nobody wanted a spendthrift roommate who ordered takeout three times a day.
spendthrift.zh: 沒人想要一個一天點三次外送的揮霍無度室友。

wasteful.en: Leaving classroom lights on all night is wasteful and raises the utility bill.
wasteful.zh: 教室燈整晚不關既浪費，又推高水電費。

improvident.en: An improvident decision to skip saving left him stranded without emergency cash.
improvident.zh: 不節儉又沒遠見地跳過存錢，讓他陷入沒有應急現金的困境。

squander.en: Do not squander the quiet weekend on endless scrolling when drafts still wait.
squander.zh: 草稿還在等你時，別把安靜週末浪費在無盡滑手機上。

dissipate.en: He would dissipate his stipend on gadgets and then borrow money for food.
dissipate.zh: 他會把津貼浪費在小裝置上，然後再借錢買吃的。

piggybank.en: She dropped spare coins into a ceramic piggybank labeled for summer travel.
piggybank.zh: 她把零錢投進標示「暑假旅行」的陶瓷存錢筒。

shredder.en: Old bank statements went into the office shredder before the recycling bin.
shredder.zh: 舊銀行對帳單先丟進辦公室碎紙機，再進回收桶。

ledger.en: The treasurer kept a neat ledger of every ticket sale for the spring play.
ledger.zh: 財務長用整齊帳本記錄春季舞台劇每一筆售票。

coupon.en: A grocery coupon for pasta sauce saved enough for an extra loaf of bread.
coupon.zh: 一張義大利麵醬折扣券，省下的錢剛好多買一條麵包。

goldcoin.en: The museum case displayed a rare goldcoin from a nineteenth-century shipwreck.
goldcoin.zh: 博物館展櫃陳列一枚來自十九世紀沉船的罕見金幣。

budget.en: Our club budget must cover both costumes and the rental of stage lights.
budget.zh: 我們社團預算必須同時負擔戲服與舞台燈光租金。

splurge.en: After months of saving, they decided to splurge on one fancy birthday dinner.
splurge.zh: 存了好幾個月後，他們決定揮霍一次、吃頓豪華生日晚餐。

savings.en: Her summer savings covered textbooks and still left money for weekend bus fare.
savings.zh: 她的暑假存款夠付課本，還剩錢付週末公車費。

voidcheck.en: The bank teller stamped VOID on the voidcheck and handed it back for records.
voidcheck.zh: 銀行櫃員在廢支票上蓋上 VOID，再交還給她留存紀錄。
